bootstrap_captured_by: Native PowerShell Get-FileHash SHA256; question and gold contents not inspected

hash_contract.raw: The declared raw sha256 captures the original working-copy bytes; another checkout may differ only in CRLF/LF form.
hash_contract.git_blob: The declared git_blob_sha256 must equal SHA256 of the tracked HEAD blob read by Git. Working bytes must match that blob directly or after CRLF-to-LF normalization. A missing Git executable or tracked blob is an integrity failure, not an unchecked pass. BOM and bare CR bytes are preserved.
